authorization: 继续下一步；隔离工具自身多套数值线程池竞争后，按原门槛继续预检及真实策略对比
inputs: byte-identical verified private tmpfs copies; retain pre/post hashes on every call; mlock inputs before preflight
outputs: own tmpfs; artifacts fsync before return; archive after all measurement; power-loss persistence not claimed
artifact_ids: session-local UUID5 of opaque fixed namespace, session key and compute ordinal; identical across policies; strict session registry validation
quality: same stage3b SYSTEM, strict final schema/artifact/reference/consumption; no posthoc normalization
failure_rule: one warmup excluded by plan only; retain every measured call; no rerun or outlier exclusion; abort before live if stability fails; stop live on first quality failure; resource gate failure invalidates acceleration inference
host_scope: affinity is not exclusive reservation; never stop others or alter global THP/NUMA/page cache settings
scope: three known development parents; targeted replication of prior 3-session anomaly; not independent holdout or full matrix
primary_metric: submit to validated correct final JCT, all checks/observer/scheduling included; prep/load/warmups/sentinels separately reported
sentinels: same controlled three-task tool group after model load (3 repeats), before and after each 3-policy cycle (one each); no copy/archive/cleanup during measured windows
preflight_preparation: runtime and inputs prepared and locked before warmup; no model copy or cleanup during measurement
tool_runtime: SHA256-verified tmpfs copy of pinned qwen-data-env site-packages; per-child PYTHONPATH fixed to this copy; mlock all copied files before warmup; system Python/stdlib remain host runtime
recipe_change: One numerical thread in every NumPy/SciPy/OpenMP pool; four logical CPUs cover two physical cores including their SMT siblings per tool. Different workload configuration from previous two-thread runs; do not pool their timings.
cpu_selection: Fixed from read-only 10-second per-CPU load/topology sample before new tool measurements; affinity is not reservation; other jobs remain unconstrained.
diagnostic: two warmups then three paired logistic two/one-thread comparisons in fixed AB/BA/AB order; choice of one thread is to remove BLAS helpers, not fastest mean selection
